description:
[CALYPSO UPLOAD FILE]
Uploads a file into the durable bucket-backed knowledge store and indexing pipeline.

Use this when you want a file indexed into the broader knowledge corpus instead of
attached directly to a single RAG chat turn. This tool returns file and task metadata.
A bucket destination is required: pass bucketIds, bucketSlugs, or bucket.
Choose exactly one file source. Use `filePath` when this MCP server runs locally and can read the path, including Claude Desktop or Cursor configs that launch this package with npx. Use `contentBase64` for hosted or remote MCP clients, browser uploads, generated in-memory content, or remote sandbox files that this MCP process cannot read. Use `sourceUrl` for a public http(s) file URL — the Calypso backend fetches it directly (public hosts only, 25MB cap), so the bytes never pass through this MCP process; filename and content type are derived from the remote response. Do not base64-encode local files just to use this tool.

bucket.description: Convenience single bucket slug for this upload. Required unless bucketIds or bucketSlugs is provided.

bucketIds.description: Existing knowledge bucket ids to assign this upload to. Required unless bucketSlugs or bucket is provided.

bucketSlugs.description: Knowledge bucket slugs to assign this upload to. Required unless bucketIds or bucket is provided.

contentBase64.description: Inline file bytes as base64. Use when filePath is not possible, such as hosted or remote MCP servers, browser-provided files, generated content, or remote sandbox attachment paths that the MCP process cannot read.

createMissingBuckets.description: If true, create missing bucket slugs before assignment.

filePath.description: Preferred for local MCP installs, including Claude Desktop and Cursor configs that run this package with a local command such as npx. Absolute or relative path readable by the machine running this MCP server. The server reads raw bytes and uploads them through the Calypso upload-session URL; no user-side base64 conversion is needed.

filename.description: Display filename for the uploaded knowledge file. Required for filePath and contentBase64 sources; derived server-side for sourceUrl.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional idempotency key for durable upload retries.

metadata.description: Optional metadata object serialized onto the upload request.

mimeType.description: Content type for the uploaded knowledge file. Required for filePath and contentBase64 sources; derived server-side for sourceUrl.

sourceUrl.description: Public http(s) URL of a file to import. The backend fetches it behind its SSRF policy (public hosts only, 25MB cap) and queues indexing. Typed errors: url_fetch_blocked, url_fetch_failed (retryable), file_too_large.

title.description: Optional human-readable title stored with the knowledge file.

waitForIndexing.description: If true, wait until indexing reaches a terminal ready state before returning.

name: calypso-upload-file
